description: Victory Aircraft-built Lancaster Mk X KB882, later converted to a Mk 10AR aerial-reconnaissance aircraft. Displayed for many years at Edmundston, New Brunswick, acquired by the National Air Force Museum of Canada in 2017 and moved to Trenton; its exterior restoration was completed in June 2024 and it is on public display in Hangar 1 at Base31 in Picton while restoration continues, with a return to Trenton planned for 2029.
